name: @pipeworx/mcp-swappa-prices

tools.name: search_device
tools.description: Find Swappa device product slugs by free-text name (e.g. "iphone 15", "galaxy s24", "macbook air"). Returns matching products with their slug (needed by device_prices / recent_sales) and current starting price. Use this first when you don't already know the exact slug.

query.description: Device name or partial name, e.g. "iPhone 15 Pro" or "Pixel 8".

tools.name: device_prices
tools.description: Current Swappa prices for a device: starting price, average price, and a breakdown table by variant (carrier/color/storage) with active-listing average and trade-in value. Accepts either a free-text device name (auto-resolved via search) or an exact slug from search_device.

tools.name: sale_prices
tools.description: Average REALIZED SALE price (not list price) per storage/variant for a device, updated daily, plus a sample of individual recent sold listings with date, condition, carrier, storage and price. This is the "what did it actually sell for" answer, distinct from device_prices (active listing averages). Accepts free-text device name or exact slug.

condition.description: Optional filter: new, mint, good, or fair.

carrier.description: Optional carrier filter, e.g. "unlocked", "att", "verizon", "t-mobile". Varies by device.

storage.description: Optional storage filter, e.g. "128gb". Varies by device.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-swappa-prices forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the swappa-prices pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
